contract: the Prism Reach, which was 96.3% ankle height and whose only content was the bare floor of a building that moved to the rim: the crystal seam breaking through the plate, growing from splinters at the Midway edge to full shards at the Prismworks threshold, with a lane off the spine through it to a note-block rail among the biggest of them. Nothing over 30 courses, so the well's collar keeps the land's silhouette.

role_contracts.construction: legal states, supported placements, stable components, and an auditable bill of materials
role_contracts.path: continuous traversable route with supported furnishings and deliberate access

brief.narrative: The crystal vein the prism well was cut to reach, breaking through the reach's dark plate: splinters at the Midway edge growing to leaning, lit shards at the Prismworks threshold, the deck heaved and broken at every foot, and a lane off the spine to a note-block rail among the biggest of them.

fun_contract.outcome: The walk from the Midway into Prismworks stops being a car park with a railway behind it.
